caption: The drawing features a single, centrally placed vase with a simple, elongated oval shape and a slightly flared neck, outlined in a thin black line. The vase has two small curved handles near the top, outlined in blue. Near the upper section of the vase, there is a cluster of blue decorative accents that resemble abstract, cloud-like or floral forms. Additionally, there is an oval-shaped label or plaque near the top center of the vase, containing a pattern of horizontal lines and small dots inside of it. The rest of the vase and the background are left uncolored, and the entire composition is set against a plain, beige-tinged background with slight discoloration and some small brown spots, mainly near the edges.
title: Jar
